name: beyondsumi
description: A frame-by-frame Sumi animation studio: writer, director, artist, animator, sound and checker, in Sumi Dark, Sumi Light and Sumi Vector.

interface.longDescription: Take a story through a writer, director, artist, animator, sound designer and checker. Every movement is a separate drawing, in Sumi Dark brush, Sumi Light colour pencil or Sumi Vector, drawn in code with no images.
defaultPrompt: Set up Beyondsumi and guide me step by step.
Help me turn my idea into a 30-second Sumi film. Ask me what you need.
Check what this computer can do, and show me what each Sumi style looks like.
